name: WATI
description: Run your WATI WhatsApp Business inbox from your AI: list approved templates, find, add and update contacts, read a contact's chat history, assign conversations to team members, and send a template message. Session, interactive and bulk sends are installed switched off.
instructions:
## WATI
This connector calls the **WATI API v1** on your workspace's own **API Endpoint** with its access token: message templates, contacts and their attributes, chat history, operator assignment, and sending template, session and interactive messages.

**Writes need a yes.** Messages go straight to the customer's WhatsApp and template messages are charged by Meta per conversation. Before `wati_send_template_message` show the template, the number and the parameter values and wait for the user's confirmation; do the same before `wati_add_contact` and `wati_update_contact_attributes`. `wati_send_session_message`, `wati_send_interactive_buttons` and `wati_send_template_broadcast` (one template to up to 1,000 numbers per call) are installed switched off: an admin turns them on deliberately, and even then confirm every send. `wati_assign_operator` only changes the shared inbox.

**Setup (about 2 minutes)**
1. Sign in to WATI and open **API Docs** in the menu (newer workspaces: **Connector, API**).
2. Copy the **API Endpoint**, e.g. `https://live-mt-server.wati.io/123456`, into `WATI_API_ENDPOINT`. The number at the end is your workspace (tenant) id.
3. Copy the **Access Token** into `WATI_ACCESS_TOKEN` **without** the word `Bearer` in front: WATI shows it as `Bearer eyJ...`, paste only the part from `eyJ` on.
The token is sent as `Authorization: Bearer ...` and only to your API Endpoint.

**Numbers and targets**: WhatsApp numbers are in international format with the country code and without `+` or spaces, e.g. `919876543210`. Where a tool asks for a `target` you can also pass a WATI contact id.

**Templates vs session messages**: outside the 24-hour window after the customer's last message WhatsApp only allows approved templates (`wati_list_message_templates`, then `wati_send_template_message`); inside the window free text (`wati_send_session_message`) and buttons (`wati_send_interactive_buttons`) are allowed. Template `parameters` are `{name, value}` pairs whose names match the template's placeholders (`{{1}}` or `{{name}}`).

**Workflow**
- Find people: `wati_list_contacts` (filter by name, attribute or creation date); read the chat with `wati_get_messages`. A contact who never chatted answers `Can't find Conversation`, reported as not found.
- Keep the CRM tidy: `wati_add_contact`, `wati_update_contact_attributes`.
- Run the inbox: `wati_assign_operator` hands a chat to a team member, or back to the bot.
- Reach out: `wati_list_message_templates`, `wati_send_template_message`; bulk with `wati_send_template_broadcast`.

**Rate limits**: contacts and messages about 10 requests per 10 seconds; template sends 30 to 100 per 10 seconds by plan. A 429 means wait and retry.

**Common errors**: 401 means the token is wrong, expired or still starts with `Bearer`; 403 means the token or your plan does not allow this call; 404 usually means a wrong API Endpoint. WATI also answers some failures with HTTP 200 and `result: false` or `ok: false` (an invalid number, a template that is not approved); the connector turns those into errors with WATI's text. A successful send means WATI accepted the message, not that it was delivered.

**Out of scope here**: WATI's newer API v3 (conversation tags and status, channels, campaigns, credits) needs a token that the API Endpoint screen does not give, so it is not used. Also out of scope: creating or deleting templates, scheduled campaigns and CSV sends, media and file messages, list and CTA messages, chatbots, segments, webhooks, WhatsApp Pay, and rotating the token.
prerequisites: A WATI workspace (Growth plan or higher) and its API Endpoint and Access Token from API Docs in WATI. About 2 minutes.

WATI_API_ENDPOINT.label: API Endpoint
WATI_API_ENDPOINT.help: WATI, API Docs: the API Endpoint, your WATI server followed by your workspace (tenant) id. Paste it as shown, without /api/v1.
WATI_API_ENDPOINT.patternMessage: Use the API Endpoint as WATI shows it, e.g. https://live-mt-server.wati.io/123456, without /api/v1 or anything after the workspace id.

WATI_ACCESS_TOKEN.label: Access token
WATI_ACCESS_TOKEN.help: WATI, API Docs: Access Token. WATI shows it with Bearer in front; paste only the token itself, starting at eyJ.
WATI_ACCESS_TOKEN.patternMessage: Paste the token without the word Bearer and without spaces.

verifyHints.401: WATI refused the access token. Copy it again from API Docs in WATI, without the Bearer in front; a token stops working when the account password changes.
verifyHints.403: WATI accepted the token but refused this request: the token lacks the scope for it, or your plan does not include the feature.
verifyHints.404: WATI does not know this address. Check WATI_API_ENDPOINT: it must be the API Endpoint from API Docs, e.g. https://live-mt-server.wati.io/123456.
verifyHints.429: WATI is rate limiting this workspace. Wait a few seconds and verify again.

tools.name: wati_list_message_templates
tools.description: List the workspace's WhatsApp message templates: id, name, category, status (APPROVED, PENDING, REJECTED), language, header, body with its placeholders, footer, buttons and custom parameters. Only APPROVED templates can be sent. Read-only.

channel_phone_number.description: Only for workspaces with several WhatsApp numbers: the sending number with country code, e.g. 85264318722.

tools.name: wati_list_contacts
tools.description: List or search the workspace's contacts, page by page: id, WhatsApp number, name, phone, status, opt-in, broadcast permission, custom attributes, teams and dates. Filter by name, an attribute condition or creation date. Read-only.

name.description: Only contacts whose name contains this text.

attribute.description: Attribute filter as JSON text, e.g. [{"name": "city", "operator": "==", "value": "Pune"}]. Operators: contain, notContain, exist, notExist, ==, !=, valid, invalid.

created_date.description: Only contacts created on this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

tools.name: wati_get_messages
tools.description: Read the chat history with one contact, newest first, page by page: message id, time, type, text, whether we sent it (owner), delivery status, operator and ticket events. Optional time window in UTC. Read-only.

target.description: WhatsApp number with country code (e.g. 919876543210) or WATI contact id.

from.description: Only messages from this time, UTC, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS'.

to.description: Only messages up to this time, UTC, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS'.

channel_phone_number.description: Only for workspaces with several WhatsApp numbers: the business number with country code.

tools.name: wati_add_contact
tools.description: Add a contact to WATI with a name and optional custom attributes. WATI also creates contacts on their own when you message a new number, so this is for building the list ahead. Tell the user what will be saved and confirm with the user first.

whatsapp_number.description: WhatsApp number with country code, without + or spaces, e.g. 919876543210.

name.description: Attribute name as set up in WATI.

custom_params.description: Custom attributes as {name, value} pairs, e.g. [{"name": "city", "value": "Pune"}].

tools.name: wati_update_contact_attributes
tools.description: Set custom attributes on a contact, e.g. order status, city or lead stage; attributes you do not pass stay as they are. Tell the user what will change and confirm with the user first.

target.description: WhatsApp number with country code (e.g. 919876543210) or WATI contact id.

name.description: Attribute name as set up in WATI.

custom_params.description: Attributes to set as {name, value} pairs, e.g. [{"name": "order_status", "value": "shipped"}].

tools.name: wati_assign_operator
tools.description: Assign a contact's conversation to a WATI team member by their email, or hand it back to the bot by leaving the email out. Internal: the customer does not see who is assigned.

target.description: WhatsApp number with country code (e.g. 919876543210) or WATI contact id.

email.description: Email of the WATI user to assign. Leave empty to assign the conversation to the bot.

channel_phone_number.description: Only for workspaces with several WhatsApp numbers: the business number with country code.

tools.name: wati_send_template_message
tools.description: Send one approved WhatsApp template to one number, the only way to write first or after the 24-hour window. Meta charges per conversation and the customer receives it at once: show template, number and values and confirm with the user first.

whatsapp_number.description: Recipient's WhatsApp number with country code, without + or spaces, e.g. 919876543210.

template_name.description: Template name (name in wati_list_message_templates); it must be APPROVED.

name.description: Placeholder name, e.g. '1' for {{1}} or 'name' for {{name}}.

parameters.description: Values for the template's placeholders as {name, value} pairs, e.g. [{"name": "1", "value": "Anna"}]. Empty for a template without placeholders.

broadcast_name.description: Label the send is grouped under in WATI's reports. Does not change the message.

channel_number.description: Only for workspaces with several WhatsApp numbers: the business number to send from, with country code.

tools.name: wati_send_template_broadcast
tools.description: Send one approved template to many numbers at once (up to 1,000 per call) with values per recipient, as a WATI broadcast. Every recipient is charged and messaged: show the list, template and values and confirm with the user first. Installed switched off.

template_name.description: Template name (name in wati_list_message_templates); it must be APPROVED.

broadcast_name.description: Name of the broadcast as it will appear in WATI's reports.

whatsappNumber.description: Recipient's number with country code, e.g. 919876543210.

customParams.description: This recipient's placeholder values as {name, value} pairs.

localMessageId.description: Optional id of your own to recognise this send in webhooks.

channel_number.description: Only for workspaces with several WhatsApp numbers: the business number to send from.

tools.name: wati_send_session_message
tools.description: Send a free-text WhatsApp message to a contact who wrote to you in the last 24 hours (open session). The customer receives it at once: show the text and confirm with the user first. Installed switched off.

target.description: WhatsApp number with country code (e.g. 919876543210) or WATI contact id.

message_text.description: Text to send. WhatsApp formatting works: *bold*, _italic_.

reply_context_id.description: Optional: WhatsApp message id (wamid) of the message you answer, to quote it.

channel_phone_number.description: Only for workspaces with several WhatsApp numbers: the business number to send from.

tools.name: wati_send_interactive_buttons
tools.description: Send a message with up to three reply buttons to a contact in an open 24-hour session, e.g. 'Track order' or 'Talk to us'. The customer receives it at once: show it and confirm with the user first. Installed switched off.

whatsapp_number.description: Recipient's WhatsApp number with country code, e.g. 919876543210.

header.description: Optional header, e.g. {"type": "Text", "text": "Your order"}, or an image {"type": "Image", "media": {"url": "https://...", "fileName": "order.jpg"}}.

footer.description: Optional small text under the message.

channel_phone_number.description: Only for workspaces with several WhatsApp numbers: the business number to send from.
